## Problem Statement
What problem are you trying to solve? Describe the situation or limitation you're
running into.

## Proposed Solution
A clear description of what you'd like to happen.

## Alternatives Considered
Any alternative solutions or features you've considered and their trade-offs.

## Use Case / Context
How would this feature be used? Who benefits from it? Concrete examples help.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, references, or links to related issues/discussions.
